correctness.rationale: The nine factors form three pencils with three coordinate triple points and nine mixed triple points (the pencil exponents sum to zero mod 3), exhausting all 36 line pairs. The W derivative vanishes only on WQ=0; there the other derivatives vanish exactly over the arrangement triple points, or at the vertex where X=Y=Z=0. Avoidance excludes all other points on Q=0 from the singular locus, including tangencies to a smooth point of a branch line. P has valuation one along each branch line, so the cubic extension is irreducible; normality follows from the hypersurface S2 condition and the isolated singular locus. At a triple point one absorbs a unit by a local cube root, producing the cone t^3=uv(u+v) over a smooth cubic E. The blowup has exceptional E with normal bundle O_E(-1); h^1(O_E)=1 and h^1(O_E(n))=0 for n>0 give local geometric genus 1. The finite normal cyclic plane V has direct-image summands O, O(-3), O(-6) on P^2 and hence chi=1+1+10=12. It has those same twelve local elliptic defects and no others, so its resolution has chi=0. T=WQ gives a birational identification for every admissible Q. The degree-nine hypersurface exact sequence gives chi=1+binomial(8,3)=57, whence the sum of local Leray defects is 57 and the vertex contributes 57-12=45. The initial form in the chart W=1 is Q^3, of degree six. Nonemptiness follows by intersecting the open smooth-conic locus with the complements of the twelve evaluation hyperplanes. This verification is algebraic, not an analytic inference from the mod-seven checker.
residual_risks: No classification of the vertex resolution graph or analytic type. The malformed P^2 TeX in the direct-image line is typographical and does not affect the argument.

evidence: The Milnor-stratification theorem allows all normal quadratic parameters, not only smooth conics; it includes the twelve simple elliptic germs and the multiplicity-six vertex of genus 45.
Chen–Lazarsfeld–Moretti give the general cyclic-cover construction of normal degree-nb models; Roulleau–Urzúa give the arrangement and elliptic-product quotient background.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The catalogue theorem specializes to all the frozen assumptions. The original cyclic-cover construction provides stronger birational information, not an explicit universal local basket. The older arrangement theorem alone would not identify this projective vertex.

evidence: Proposition A identifies the very equation for generic Q as birational to E times E. A resolution thus has chi=0, whereas the nonic has chi=57.
For any admissible Q the field identification T=WQ extends the birational conclusion; the derivative test and ordinary triple crossings give twelve cubic cones, and the initial vertex form is Q^3.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Even independently of exact catalogue coverage, the requested defect is a routine consequence of the prior model: subtract twelve unit local defects from the global defect 57. Smoothness of Q supplies the conic description of the tangent cone. No uncomputed local-resolution contribution is needed.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed record on normality and Milnor jumps of the identical abelian nonic gives the same basket and local genera on a larger parameter domain. Separately, the exact invariant follows from the earlier birational abelian model by the local cone calculation and the hypersurface Leray difference. The larger conic domain than 'generic Q' does not rescue the claim: all admissible Q have the same function field and the same other twelve local defects. The distinct catalogue match establishes coverage rather than an ordering of same-day records.
